request: I'm flying to Singapore for a two-week field campaign. It's nearly seventeen hours nonstop, so please put me in business class.

trip.purpose: field campaign with a partner university

must_keep.quote: Coach class or any discounted class shall be used in the interest of cost-efficiency. This policy applies to all travel (domestic or foreign, or any combination thereof) regardless of the purpose or fund source.
must_keep.why: coach is the rule for every trip, however long

must_keep.quote: Use of business or first-class may be authorized under the circumstances listed below.
must_keep.why: business only under a listed circumstance

must_keep.quote: In cases other than those described above, a written authorization to use business or first-class shall be obtained in advance from the Chancellor.
must_keep.why: outside the list, only the Chancellor's advance written authorization

distractors.quote: When a traveler prefers to use a higher class than the one authorized for reimbursement, the traveler must pay the incremental cost of the airfare.
distractors.why: who pays a self-chosen upgrade; not a way to book one

design_notes: G-28 has no flight-length threshold: coach for all travel (lines 567-569); none of the four listed circumstances holds and no written Chancellor authorization is on file (lines 588-592). The fund is not federal, so Fly America does not arise.
